title: Cache transcript nested-scrollable wheel classification per event
outcome: The pane capture arbiter, pane wheel handler, normalized intent handler, and virtualizer each call canNestedScrollableConsumeWheel for the same WheelEvent. Each call walks ancestors and invokes getComputedStyle on non-passive wheel listeners, adding repeated forced-style work to the hottest transcript input path. Cache the normalized direction and nested-consumer verdict in a WeakMap keyed by WheelEvent and share it across all consumers.
acceptance: One DOM/style ancestor walk occurs per WheelEvent; all pane and virtualizer consumers receive the same verdict; nested-scroller ownership and top-level transcript wheel behavior remain unchanged; focused performance-contract tests and UI gates pass.
